plan.title: School Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Enrolment trends, infrastructure gaps, and gender disparities in education

panels.title: Total schools inspected
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "School Code") AS n FROM "school_infrastructure"

panels.title: Average enrolment by block
panels.sql: SELECT "Block", AVG("Girls 2022") AS avg_girls_2022, AVG("Girls 2023") AS avg_girls_2023, AVG("Girls 2024") AS avg_girls_2024, AVG("Boys 2022") AS avg_boys_2022, AVG("Boys 2023") AS avg_boys_2023, AVG("Boys 2024") AS avg_boys_2024 FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Annual enrolment trend for girls
panels.sql: SELECT "Year" AS year, SUM("Girls 2022") AS total_girls_2022, SUM("Girls 2023") AS total_girls_2023, SUM("Girls 2024") AS total_girls_2024 FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 schools by number of classrooms
panels.sql: SELECT "School Name", "Classrooms" AS classrooms FROM "school_infrastructure" ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This dashboard provides an overview of school enrolment trends, infrastructure conditions, and gender disparities. {{p1}} schools have been inspected, with average enrolment varying significantly across blocks. The bar chart shows the average number of girls and boys enrolled per block for the years 2022, 2023, and 2024. The line chart illustrates the total number of girls enrolled annually across all schools. The table lists the top 10 schools with the highest number of classrooms, highlighting potential capacity for expansion or resource allocation.
